findings.title: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies and converts `config` but returns the unconverted original
findings.description: In `get_monitor_environment_context`, `config` is a copy of `monitor.config`. The function sets `config["schedule_type"]` to the display value on that copy, then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` in the `"config"` key. The converted copy is never used, so the returned context carries the raw schedule type while the code appears to intend the display string. The fix is to return `config` in that field.

findings.title: `SimpleCheckIn` in `types.py` depends on `TypedDict` and `datetime` imports that are not shown in the hunk
findings.description: The added `SimpleCheckIn(TypedDict)` uses `TypedDict` and `datetime` annotations. The hunk does not add these imports. They may already exist in the file, but I could not confirm that without reading it.

findings.title: Renamed and moved symbols may leave stale references in callers or tests
findings.description: `mark_failed_threshold` is renamed to `try_incident_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence` is renamed to `create_incident_occurrence`, and `SimpleCheckIn` moves from `mark_failed.py` to `monitors/types.py`. Any remaining import of the old names, such as `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import SimpleCheckIn`, or any call to the old function names would fail at import or call time. I could not search for these references.
